title: What it’s like to live rural - my country cottage experience
en: salutations at the time of making this video it is 7 a.m when i wake up every single morning not buying my own accord so much as that my dog iger decides around this time that i have slept long enough let me know if your schedule is also dictated by animals today i wanted to reflect a bit on what my home has taught me these are my personal experiences and they have guided me in many ways one thing i quickly learned once i moved is that your space complements your happiness but can't necessarily sustain it my cottage taught me that i am responsible for my own satisfaction in life we often fill our minds with what-ifs and dreams of living somewhere beautiful that melts away our troubles but from my experience this isn't an effective long-term remedy the excitement of living here temporarily distracted me from my troubles but eventually i had to face them if i didn't the void in my spirit would poison each new environment i found forcing me to keep moving and trying new things in order to outrun personal growth as a side note i know some people were wondering how and where i shower and the answer is kind of strange in the summertime i have a little outdoor extension

that works really well but in the winter when it's cold and i can't have heated water i go to a tiny house that is actually connected to the property and right behind my cottage it is currently empty and so i'm able to use the facilities do something else i learned is that some inconveniences are a matter of perspective it can be easy to see a flushing toilet a stable internet connection and various other resources as necessary for comfortable living this may be true for some people and i absolutely respect their preference but as for me i have found much freedom in altering my mindset away from wants and towards needs i don't have a shower inside my cottage i use a compost toilet and i have to take a short walk every day in order to get a stable connection to the internet i do my work on my computer and then increasingly disconnect for the rest of the day don't get me wrong i love technology and it is a wonderful resource at home i use it intentionally listening to audiobooks watching pre-downloaded videos and documentaries i try to use technology in a way that benefits me and makes me feel more energized

instead of inadequate and mentally dull which i find i feel sometimes after staring at my phone for a long time this is only my experience and of course i would love to hear yours so another inconvenience i've learned to deal with is looking forward to traveling out of town in order to buy bulk groceries food in town is a bit limited and expensive so i try to stock up when i can i've had friends who visit who have found these inconveniences very troublesome since they're used to having these things available all the time i've come to see these limitations as a small price to pay for all the other resources available to me such as endless hiking trails substantial land to use for gardening and honestly the beauty of the mountains and forests and grasslands that being said rural living is definitely not for everyone so

do so ne of the biggest lessons i've received one of the biggest lessons i've received from my cottage is that boredom is not only underrated it is a tool that has endless potential for creativity and innovation when you take something out of your life you often naturally fill it with something new the less time you spend on your phone or maybe doing other more mindless tasks the more you realize how important it is to have hobbies or interests that are your own be it learning new things like creating art going on adventures writing planning for example i would have never started my youtube channel or my etsy shop if i hadn't found myself without anything in particular to do in my free time so i decided that i wanted to start working on making my passions into something that would help me sustain myself in the future lastly my cottage has also reminded me

to be ever more grateful i live in an environment of extremes with burning hot summers and icy winters i'm so grateful for warmth windows a furnace and winter i also recognize all the little blessings that have brought me to where i am and cherish each in my heart in a future video i wish to speak more on my unusual childhood and wonderful family my thank you all for your lovely comments and support i truly wish i could reach out to each one of you and answer you personally while that is not possible for me know that i read all that you send me and that i deeply appreciate it sending my love have a lovely day or night
zh: 制作此视频时的问候是早上 7 点，我每天早上醒来，不买自己的意愿，以至于我的狗 iger 在这个时候决定我睡得足够长，请告诉我，今天您的日程安排是否也是由动物决定的，我想反思一下我的家教给我的东西，这些是我的个人经历，它们在很多方面指导了我，搬家后我很快学到的一件事是，你的空间补充了你的幸福，但不一定能维持它，我的小屋教给我我对自己的生活满意度负责，我们经常在脑海中充满假设和梦想，生活在一个美丽的地方，消除我们的烦恼，但从我的经验来看，这不是一个有效的长期补救措施，住在这里的兴奋暂时分散了我对烦恼的注意力，但最终我必须面对它们，如果我不这样做，我精神上的空虚会毒害我发现的每一个新环境，迫使我不断前进和尝试新事物，以超越个人成长作为旁注，我知道有些人想知道我如何以及在哪里洗澡和夏天的时候答案有点奇怪我有一点户外扩展

这确实很好用，但在冬天，天气很冷，我没有热水时，我会去一栋实际上与酒店相连的小房子，就在我的小屋后面，它目前是空的，所以我可以使用这些设施做其他事情，我了解到，一些不便只是一个角度问题，很容易看到冲水马桶、稳定的互联网连接和舒适生活所需的各种其他资源，这对某些人来说可能是正确的，我绝对尊重他们的偏好，但对我来说，我找到了很多自由在改变我的心态，从欲望转向需求的过程中，我的小屋里没有淋浴，我使用堆肥厕所，我每天必须走一小段路，才能稳定地连接到互联网。充满活力的

我有时会在长时间盯着手机后感到不足和精神迟钝，但这只是我的经验，当然我很想听听你的经验，所以我学会处理的另一个不便之处是期待出城去购买散装杂货，城里的食物有点有限和昂贵，所以我会尽可能地囤货，我有一些来访的朋友发现这些不便非常麻烦，因为他们已经习惯了这些东西都可用现在，我开始将这些限制视为支付我可用的所有其他资源的一个小代价，例如无尽的远足小径，用于园艺的大量土地，老实说，美丽的山脉、森林和草原，话虽这么说，乡村生活绝对不适合所有人，所以

我从我的小屋中得到的最重要的教训之一是，无聊不仅被低估，它还是一种具有无限创造力和创新潜力的工具，当你从生活中拿走一些东西时，你经常自然地用新的东西填充它，你花在手机上的时间越少，或者可能做其他更不需要动脑子的任务，你就越意识到拥有自己的爱好或兴趣是多么重要，无论是学习新事物，比如创造艺术，还是冒险，写计划，例如，我永远不会开始我的生活。 youtube 频道或我的 etsy 商店，如果我在空闲时间没有发现自己没有什么特别可做的事情，所以我决定开始努力将我的热情变成可以帮助我在未来维持自己的东西，最后我的小屋也提醒了我

更加感激的是，我生活在一个极端的环境中，夏天炎热，冬天冰冷，我非常感激温暖的窗户，火炉和冬天，我也认识到所有把我带到这里的小祝福，并在未来的视频中珍惜我心中的每一个祝福，我希望更多地谈论我不寻常的童年和美好的家庭，谢谢你们所有人的可爱评论和支持，我真的希望我能联系到你们每一个人，亲自回答你们，虽然这对我来说是不可能的，但我知道我读了你们发给我的所有内容，我深深地感激它送我的爱有一个美好的白天或夜晚
